title: About us
body:
We are a modern online store bringing fashion, electronics, groceries and more to your door.

Our promise: fair prices, genuine products and fast delivery.

seo.description: Learn about our store and what we stand for.

title: Frequently asked questions
body:
How long does delivery take?

Most orders arrive within 3 to 5 working days.

Can I return an item?

Eligible items can be returned within 7 days of delivery.

Which payment methods do you accept?

UPI, cards, net banking, wallets and cash on delivery.
